name: hotspot-image
title: Hotspot image
description: A picture with numbered markers that open a note, for annotated product shots, floor plans and diagrams. Percent positions, 44px targets, notes that stay on screen.
docs: hotspots is a list of { id, x, y, title, body }: x and y are percentages of the picture (0 to 100), so a marker stays on its spot at any width, and the order of the list is the number and the Tab order. Give ratio the shape of your picture (default 3 / 2) so the markers land where you put them. Control the open note with activeId and onActiveChange (null means none), or leave both out; defaultActiveId opens one at load, but a floating note open at load puts a focus guard at each end of the page, so the first Tab lands on an invisible stop. A note floats next to its marker and flips and shifts to stay fully on screen; in a picture narrower than 30rem it opens in a panel under the picture instead, so on a phone it never covers the picture or the page. The markers are white with a dark number in both themes, because a picture does not follow the theme. showList repeats every note as a numbered list under the picture, for screen readers and for phones. Each marker is named '2: Living room'. Tab from an open note moves on to the next marker, Shift+Tab returns to its own, Escape closes. The notes are read-only text; it is not a tour and not a place for comments.
